audit.whatIsWrong: content win[] gives Ziggs six straight stages and full.phases gives him all seven at 3/10, while whys[2] says Level 3 evens out as E charges let Aatrox gapclose, whys[3] says 4-5 Aatrox can bait W and all-in, whys[4] says World Ender eats a poke rotation and still kills him, and whys[5] says first-item drain plus mobility wins the all-in. The packet chart reads Ziggs, Skill, Aatrox, Aatrox, Aatrox, Aatrox, Skill.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is his only escape at 20s rank 1, against Umbral Dash refreshing every 9s down to 5s. Once Aatrox has charges the lane is decided by whether the satchel is up, which is exactly what the entry's prose says and its chart denies. 51.29% over 1866 games.
audit.corrected: Level 1 stays Ziggs; Level 2 evens; Levels 3 through First item read Aatrox; Two+ items stays even.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mega Inferno Bomb is never mentioned anywhere in the matchup — not in the Level 6 spike, not in late, not in wants.foe. The Level 6 spike talks only about Satchel Charge.
audit.why: Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70 with a 5000 range, which means Ziggs's level-6 spike is not a lane-combat spike at all: it is the ability to delete a wave or finish a low target from off-screen. That is why he takes plates and zones your split, and it is the reason to back before a low recall rather than walking a sliver of health down the lane. Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1 and Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s.
audit.corrected: Mega Inferno Bomb named with its 120s cooldown and 5000 range in late.

audit.why: The two decisive interactions are already stated correctly in the content layer after a mid-session applier run: Satchel Charge as his only escape on 20s with the self-knock that costs him no health, and Hexplosive Minefield dealing reduced damage on each successive detonation against the same target, which is why running straight through it beats edging around. The remaining gap was the full-layer tldr, still on the template string.
audit.corrected: tldr rewritten around the 20s Satchel Charge and the minefield's diminishing repeat damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] says he self-knocks away 'the moment you dash in', which teaches the player to expect it on their engage and therefore to hold the dash.
audit.why: Satchel Charge detonates after a delay OR when re-activated, so a Ziggs who has thrown it is holding a button, not reacting to your dash. The mistake to warn against is dashing onto a satchel that is already on the ground — that is the one he detonates for free. Engage from a direction with no charge placed and the 20s window is genuinely yours.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] rewritten to name the placed charge rather than the reaction.

edits.before: Ziggs scales into a poke-and-zone monster: after first item he out-ranges you in grouped fights, waveclears to shove your split, and chunks you before you commit — but on a landed all-in you still delete him, so the item-phase matchup is roughly even. Buy Mercury's Treads, use E charges to force the 1v1, and never let him free-poke; the whole game is closing that gap.
edits.after: Ziggs scales into a poke-and-zone monster: he out-ranges you grouped, shoves your split, and Mega Inferno Bomb (120s) reaches 5000 units, so a low recall down the lane is a free kill for him — back early. On a landed all-in you still delete him, so the item phase is roughly even. Buy Mercury's Treads, use E charges to force the 1v1, and never let him free-poke.

edits.before: Self-knock away with W satchel the moment you dash in
edits.after: Bait you onto a placed satchel, then detonate it

edits.before: Ziggs changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Ziggs Satchel, bombs, E zone, and R. Aatrox wins by controlling spacing with his first two Q swings, holding E until the enemy punish tool is committed, and managing the wave so the enemy must walk into the outer edge of his Q. Ziggs wants to keep distance, poke Aatrox before he can reach the wave, and punish missed Qs with ranged damage or crowd control.
edits.after: Ziggs changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Satchel Charge (W, 20s), his only escape, which throws Ziggs himself clear and costs him nothing, and Bouncing Bomb reaching 850 units every 6s. Aatrox wins by engaging from a side with no charge placed, all-inning inside those 20 seconds, and running straight through Hexplosive Minefield, whose repeat detonations do less each time.
